power_calculation_model: Two-Way Cross-Clustered Asymptotic McNemar Formulation (Cameron & Miller 2015, Kish 1965)

provisional_design_evaluation.assessment: INSUFFICIENT POWER. A sample of 1,500 pairs achieves only 53.38% statistical power under realistic candidate and job clustering (ICC_c=0.20, ICC_j=0.10). An unadjusted N=1,500 overestimates effective statistical evidence by a factor of 2.05x.

alternative_low_correlation_design.description: If pairs are strictly one-to-one (1 pair per candidate, 1 pair per job), DEFF = 1.0.
alternative_low_correlation_design.feasibility_assessment: Recruitment matching requires evaluating candidates against competing jobs. The 2,850-pair cross-clustered design is more practically and domain-wise defensible.
